note: `all` takes a `badgeId`: an administrator lists every giving of one badge, never of the whole community at once.
`all` is sent only as `true`; a member's own list is the default, not `all: false`.
`direction` is `received` or `given`; there is no third party's view.
There is no `entryId`: a member lists only their own kudos, never another member's.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
Response variant: `nextCursor` is `null`. On the last page it is absent, never `null`.
